spotify.show_song: No access_token. Fields: duration is in SECONDS (no duration_ms), play_count, rating, like_count, release_date, genre, artists [{id,name}].
spotify.show_song_privates: Returns only booleans (liked, reviewed, in_song_library, downloaded). No play_count.
spotify.show_album: No access_token parameter. Songs are under 'songs' (dicts with 'id'), not 'song_ids'.
spotify.show_playlist: Songs are under 'songs' (dicts with 'id'), not 'song_ids'. Pass access_token for private playlists.
spotify.search_artists: No access_token. Use genre= and min_follower_count= filters; artist fields: artist_id, name, genre, follower_count. page_limit max 20.
spotify.show_song_reviews: No access_token. Use user_email= to find your own review. The review id key is 'song_review_id'. Use helper set_my_rating.
spotify.review_song: Fails if you already reviewed that song; then use update_song_review(review_id).
spotify.play_music: Playing a bare song_id queues only that song; to play a song from an album/playlist, play that album_id/playlist_id then use queue_position.
phone.login: The username is the supervisor PHONE NUMBER, not the email.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: No parameters. Returns the app's 'today' (e.g. 'Thursday, May 18, 2023'); use it, not datetime.now().
phone.search_contacts: The ONLY contacts API (no get_contacts). Needs phone token. relationship= filter and a 'relationships' LIST on each contact. phone_number field per contact. page_limit<=20.
venmo.search_users: Fuzzy search returning unrelated users; never empty. Match by exact email. Cannot look up phone numbers.
venmo.show_transactions: Returns sender/receiver {name,email}; no direction field. min_created_at/max_created_at are YYYY-MM-DD. page_limit max 20.
file_system.show_directory: NOT paginated (no page_index/page_limit). recursive defaults True (includes subfolders): pass recursive=False for 'in the X directory'.
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path, content, access_token, overwrite. No allow_if_exists.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path, access_token, overwrite, retain_dates.
spotify.search_songs: query is fuzzy text and returns the WHOLE catalog. To get one artist's songs pass artist_id= (from search_artists). Rows already have play_count, rating, duration (seconds). Also min_play_count=, genre=, sort_by='-play_count'. Paginate (page_limit<=20).
spotify.show_song_queue: Needs access_token; NOT paginated. Entries: song_id, position, is_current, is_playing, artists [{id,name}]. 'Played so far incl. current' = position <= current position.
spotify.show_recommendations: The source of 'recommended' songs; needs access_token, paginate. Items lack release_date/genre: call show_song per id to filter.
spotify.show_following_artists: Followed artists; needs access_token and page_limit=20 (default page is only 5); paginate to an empty page. Key is artist_id.
spotify.show_liked_albums: Albums you liked; needs access_token; paginate. Use with show_liked_songs when a task says 'liked'.
spotify.add_song_to_playlist: One song per call (playlist_id, song_id, access_token). There is no bulk add or remove_songs_from_playlist.
venmo.show_social_feed: Transactions of your friends AND yourself (sender/receiver {name,email}, created_at). No date/direction filter: filter client-side. Use it when the task says 'social feed'; show_transactions only has your own.
venmo.create_transaction: Privacy: pass private=True ('privately') or private=False; there is no privacy= parameter (unknown params are not sent). If 'balance does not have $X': pass payment_card_id from show_payment_cards, try each; never add_to_venmo_balance.
phone.search_text_messages: Pass phone_number=<number> to filter one contact; read the incoming message text before replying. Items have text_message_id (used by delete_text_message).
simple_note.show_note: Returns dict with 'content'. Print the whole note and read it; notes may hold several blocks with fields (e.g. '- key: value' lines); use the block that matches the task.
phone.update_alarm: To move/change an alarm use update_alarm(alarm_id, time=..., enabled=...) on the existing alarm; do not create+delete. Change only the fields asked.
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: MY outgoing requests (not in show_transactions). Entries: payment_request_id, receiver{name,email}, created_at, approved_at, denied_at. Paginate.
venmo.remind_payment_request: Takes payment_request_id (int) of a request you sent.
spotify.delete_account: Terminate/close/delete my account = this API (access_token). Supervisor has no such API. Call it last, after other work is verified.
spotify.show_artist: No song list. Use search_songs(artist_id=) or helper songs_of_artist.
spotify.update_song_review: Needs review_id = the 'song_review_id' value from show_song_reviews(song_id=, user_email=). Use helper set_my_rating.
file_system.compress_directory: compressed_file_path must end .zip or .tar (as the task names); delete_directory=True deletes the SOURCE directory; never compress a container that holds the real target folders.
simple_note.search_notes: The query is ignored: it returns ALL notes. fetch_all them, show_note each, pick by content (note_shares / note_blocks helpers), never result [0].
